description: This is an ASP.NET Web Forms code-behind file for the StartExam page, handling user session validation, course selection based on user semester, and initiating exams (Theory or MCQ) with database interactions.

classes.name: StartExam
classes.description: Code-behind class for the ASP.NET StartExam page, managing session validation, course selection, and exam start logic.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles page load event, validates user session, retrieves user's semester info, and populates the course dropdown based on the semester.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Transfers user to the Dashboard page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Transfers user to the UserProfile page.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Transfers user to the Leaderboard page.

methods.name: selectB_Click
methods.description: Placeholder for select button click; currently does nothing.

methods.name: startB_Click
methods.description: Initiates the exam based on selected type (Theory or MCQ), checks database for available questions, and sets session variables before starting the exam.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user and redirects to the login page.

methods.name: GridView1_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Handles student selecting a theory exam; checks if already taken, sets start question number, and redirects to the exam page.

methods.name: GridView2_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Handles student selecting an MCQ exam; checks if already taken, sets start question, and redirects to the exam page.
